verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI offers conversation checkpointing to save/resume sessions (gh-8), which provides a rudimentary rollback mechanism, and GEMINI.md context files could be version-controlled as plain files, but there is no dedicated versioning, diffing, or review system for automations themselves. missing for 10: explicit automation/workflow versioning, a review/audit trail for changes to automations, and a documented rollback mechanism beyond session checkpoints.
